hints.title: Fraction Structure
hints.text: A fraction numerator / denominator is simplified between 0 and 1 if 1 <= numerator < denominator and gcd(numerator, denominator) == 1.

hints.title: Nested Loops
hints.text: Iterate denominator d from 2 to n, and numerator num from 1 to d - 1.

hints.title: Check Coprimality
hints.text: If gcd(num, d) == 1, format the fraction as string num/d and append it to the result.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating float decimals introduces precision inaccuracies when comparing equivalence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Euclidean GCD test is fast and guarantees mathematically irreducible fractions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses GCD == 1 condition across pairs 1 <= num < denom <= n.
complexity.notes: Any order of output is accepted.

solutions.approach: coprime numerator and denominator generation via Euclidean GCD
